what: First part of world's largest SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition upgrade live: 50,000 users in 112 countries; rest of Group due within two years.
Global S/4HANA go-live after reset: program run-rate cost cut ~50%; 103 billion records migrated in 72 hours; ~95% of markets by net sales live within four days.
FUSION big-bang: two global ECC systems merged into one S/4HANA template for ~100 affiliates, 775 million records migrated, ~23 TB data downsized, 870 days.
Two SAP systems moved to SAP cloud on S/4HANA: 27,000 users, 1,500+ interfaces, €22bn revenue, no major incidents reported (project lead's post).
SAP data replicated to Snowflake on Azure during one of the industry's largest S/4HANA migrations; real-time access for ~35,000 users across 11 bottlers, faster close.
AI digital twins on SAP digital core: 20% waste cut and 10% capacity gain at Raeford; nearly 30% waste cut in Poznan; 40+ more twins planned in 18 months.
Migrated entire SAP estate (four core ERPs, ~350 systems, 25–30 TB per regional ERP) to Azure in 18 months; 20-30% faster critical business processes.
Multi-year ECC-to-S/4HANA migration across ~80 countries in progress; Celonis connected to top 25 systems of record as process backbone. No results reported yet.
Replacing ~11 ERPs with one S/4HANA Fashion instance on Azure across 110 countries; US, Canada, India and 14 Asia-Pacific countries live, Europe next summer; ~80% done.
Pre-migration data cleanup for S/4HANA: 99.89% of old open SAP records archived (partner TJC Group); S/4HANA migration with Bluefield custom-code automation still ahead.
